name: Chalice Brands Ltd
summary: Chalice Brands Ltd. is engaged in the development, processing, and distribution of medical cannabis products. The firm offers products under the Golden XTRX, Proper, and Left Coast Connection brands. It's brands include Chalice Farms, Golden, Jackpot, Elysium Fields, and RXO (RSO+GO). The company was founded on April 12, 2011 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
